howto.name: Upload the PDF
howto.text: Drop one or more PDFs, up to 500 MB each. It works on pages with real text: a scanned page is one full-page image, so it is left as it is.

howto.name: Let auto-detection scan
howto.text: PrivaTools finds the area covered by the text and images on each page using PyMuPDF. Everything counts, including a page number in the margin, while vector drawings such as lines and boxes are not detected and can be trimmed away.

howto.name: Download the cropped PDF
howto.text: Click Auto Crop. Each page's visible area (its CropBox) is set to that box plus a 20-point margin; the rest of the page stays in the file, hidden.

faq.q: Will this make text run off the page?
faq.a: Not text or images: a 20-point margin is kept around them. Vector graphics such as lines, boxes and charts drawn as shapes are not detected, so they can end up outside the new area. A page with no text or images is left as it is.

faq.q: What if my PDF has different page sizes after scanning?
faq.a: Auto-crop computes the bounding box per-page, so pages are independently cropped to their own content.

The pages become smaller than the paper, so choose how your print dialog should place them, for example Fit to page. Do not run Resize afterwards: it removes the crop box and brings the whole page back.
